create_EvaluatorPose: create an EvaluatorPose instance with a list of object IDs to track 6D pose evaluation metrics
update_EvaluatorPose_update: update the evaluator with estimated and ground truth poses to compute MSPD, MSSD, and inlier error metrics
update_EvaluatorPose_update_without_anno: update the evaluator with estimated poses only when ground truth annotations are unavailable
save_results_EvaluatorPose_save_results_: save all 6D pose estimates with scores, rotation, translation, and error metrics to a JSON file
save_metrics_EvaluatorPose_save_metrics: save per-class evaluation metrics including MSSD, MSPD, inlier ratios, and error percentiles to a TSV file
